An '''intermix cowling'''<ref name="SS">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref> or '''thrust intermix cowling'''<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component<ref name="SS" /> that required adequate shielding.<ref name="SSR" /> [[Gideon (spacer)|Gideon]] and [[Keeta]] visited [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] to purchase a new intermix cowling since their ship, the ''[[Independent Class]]'', would melt through used ones.<ref name="SS" />
